module_summary: Ten-state timer-control FSM: detects a 1101 start pattern on a serial input, enables a shifter for exactly four cycles, signals counting until an external done-counting input, then holds done until acknowledged.

anchors.name: n14_1f2
anchors.why: Pattern-search, four shift states, counting and wait-for-ack states; decodes all outputs.

anchors.name: n17_f3c
anchors.why: Shift enable asserted for four cycles after pattern detection.

anchors.name: n12_7d2
anchors.why: Counting indication, high while waiting for done-counting.

anchors.name: n7_ccc
anchors.why: Acknowledge returning the FSM to pattern search.

anchors.name: n16_a72
anchors.why: External done-counting response ending the counting state.

groups.name: timer_fsm
groups.description: Pattern detector, shift/count sequencing and output decode.
